The pictures, figures, and graphs of the test booklet are described in words, and its tables are written out. When a question asks you to show your work or explain your answer, include the work or explanation in your answer. For a multiple-choice question, choose one option.

output.answer_1: I would draw a line from one corner of the rectangle to the opposite corner. This makes a diagonal line that cuts across the rectangle. It would create two triangles.
output.answer_2: I would draw a line straight down from the middle of the left side to the middle of the right side. This would split the rectangle exactly in half, making two smaller rectangles.
output.answer_3: I would draw a line straight down from the middle of the left side to the middle of the right side, like in question 2. Then I would draw a line from the bottom left corner of the rectangle to the middle of the bottom side. This creates one rectangle and two triangles.
